shapeSummary: Single hinge block, 24 x 12 x 16 mm (X x Y x Z). A 12 mm diameter barrel with its axis along Z sits at one end on a flat-bottomed base. A 4 mm thick tab extends along +X and ends in an 8 mm radius round end. A 4.2 mm through bore runs along Z through the barrel. A 4.2 mm through hole runs along Y in the tab round end.
warnings: No dimensions were given in the text, so all sizes are estimates from the analysis bounds.
The hole positions in the analysis were inconsistent, so the hole layout was re-derived from the image: the tab hole and barrel bore axes are perpendicular, 10 mm apart in X.
Tab thickness (4 mm), barrel radius (6 mm) and base height (6 mm) are guesses.
The 45° grooves and the notches on the rounded end are omitted.
No fillets or edge breaks are modeled.
cadquery:
barrel = cq.Workplane('XY').center(-6, 6).circle(6).extrude(8, both=True)
base = cq.Workplane('XY').box(12, 6, 16, centered=(False, False, True)).translate((-12, 0, 0))
tab_box = cq.Workplane('XY').box(10, 4, 16, centered=(False, False, True)).translate((-6, 0, 0))
tab_round = cq.Workplane('XZ').center(4, 0).circle(8).extrude(-4)
part = barrel.union(base).union(tab_box).union(tab_round)
bore = cq.Workplane('XY').center(-6, 6).circle(2.1).extrude(10, both=True)
tab_hole = cq.Workplane('XZ').center(4, 0).circle(2.1).extrude(-12)
part = part.cut(bore).cut(tab_hole)
